remarks: Welcome to 54 Camp Avenue in the heart of Darien - a beautifully updated, move-in ready home offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality. This inviting 4-bedroom, 2 full bathroom residence features recently renovated bathrooms with heated floors and a thoughtfully designed layout. The dining and living area opens seamlessly to an expansive new deck that overlooks a private and serene property where you can enjoy peaceful views of the large, private backyard...an ideal setting for gatherings, play, or quiet relaxation. The home also includes a finished lower level, providing valuable additional living space that can be used as a family room, home office, gym, or guest area. With its turnkey condition, modern updates, desirable location and scenic property 54 Camp Avenue presents a wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy living in Darien.
